reviewed_pages.evidence: Undisturbed samples with directly measured pressure and water content; the saturation anchor may instead be total porosity.
Heads standardized to cm with source conversion factors in raw comments. Heads rounded to three significant figures. Texture sums may be adjusted. The database contains 445 sites/profiles.

VG Mualem optimization boxes: residual [0,0.533], saturation [0.1,0.96], alpha [0.00001,0.99999] cm^-1, n [1.01,15]. These are optimization restrictions, not validated confidence or applicability ranges.

import_decisions: Import all positive-head raw rows without interpolation or deletion of nonmonotone values.
Defer every zero-head value, including 289 porosity-derived anchors and 786 reported saturation values.
Keep measured-target digitization, replicate averaging and pressure conversion comments in a local sidecar.
Do not import fitted parameters or estimated retention values as observations.
Do not infer predictor methods, material basis, external calibration independence or coverage qualification.

Block 664 positive-head points in 88 horizons whose source comments declare 1atm=1020cm. Other comments use 1atm=1033cm. Preserve original heads and defer interpretation pending original-source review.
